components.name: relative rotational angular displacement detection device

provenance.quote: A relative rotational angular displacement detection device, comprising:
a pair of rotatable members rotatable relative to each other about an axis of rotation in a circumferential direction;
permanent magnet attached to one of the pair of rotatable members and including magnetic poles magnetized in an axial direction
magnetic flux guiding ring including an annular ring body, the annular ring body being attached to the other of the pair of rotatable members
the annular ring body including an annular plane portion that extends in a direction intersecting with the axial direction of the axis of rotation
a plurality of protruding portions each having a circumferential width, the plurality of protruding portions protruding from the annular ring body toward one side
magnetic detection unit facing one surface of the annular ring body with a gap therebetween with respect to the axial direction
magnetic sensor for detecting magnetic fluxes oriented in the axial direction of the axis of rotation
intermediate yoke having a first plane portion arranged between the magnetic sensor and the annular ring body
first plane portion surface area smaller than annular plane portion
a shaft, an axis of which being the axis of rotation
elastic member arranged between the pair of rotatable members, configured to constantly apply a biasing force in a relative rotation direction
restriction part configured to prevent rotation of members relative to other after a first member is rotated relative to a second through a predetermined angle
rotation driving member connected to a first of the pair of rotatable members, configured such that a user gives a rotational force thereto
power source configured to give a rotational force to a second of the pair of rotatable members
control unit configured to, when first member rotated relative to second through a predetermined angle, control the power source force depending on magnetic detection output
